Meta.defaultTitle: Sword & Blade · The Wall of Blades
Meta.description: From Eastern swords to the blades of myth, a sword shop carved into a plaster wall (a fictional portfolio store)

Footer.disclaimer: This is a fictional store built for a portfolio. All products, workshops, prices and orders are made up; nothing is sold or shipped.
Footer.customs: Duties and VAT are estimates based on example rates. In Korea, owning a blade of 15 cm or longer requires a permit from the local police, and importing one requires a permit from the National Police Agency.
Footer.adminNote: · Prices, stock and duty rates you change there show up in this shop right away. The admin is available in Korean only.
Footer.tagline: Illustrations drawn in code · No real blades were harmed
